If i can’t see I can’t see why are you putting me under extra strain??

When I told her that I concentrated completely despite the guy taking way more time than usual (understandable, I’m grateful that he gave extra time honestly) I sat and clicked when he showed the white lights and then they’re saying that I wasn’t clicking at all white lights. But that was the test! If i cant see how will I click? She tells me that “oh if you did everything right then your report is reliable  and you can show it to your neurologist”

If this was the case then why did you yourself initially tell us that it’s not reliable? on what basis? why confuse the patients before?
